params.expectedColumns: Employee Number, Last Name, First Name, Middle Name, Plan Name, Grant Name, Grant Type, Employee Grant Number, Grant Date, Vesting Start Date, Service Start Date, Original VCD (migrated grants), Expire Date, Expire Date (participant view), Earliest Expire Cancel Date, Latest Expire Cancel Date, No. of Shares Granted, Exercise Price per Share, Vesting Schedule, Early Exercise Allowed, No. of Shares Vested, No. of Shares Unvested, Shares Exercised / Released, Shares Subject To Repurchase, Shares Cancelled/Expired, Shares Outstanding, Outstanding Unvested, Outstanding Vested/Exercisable

select
  [Employee Number],
  [Last Name],
  [First Name],
  [Middle Name],
  [Plan Name],
  [Grant Name],
  [Grant Type],
  [Employee Grant Number],
  [Grant Date],
  [Vesting Start Date],
  [Service Start Date],
  [Original VCD (migrated grants)],
  [Expire Date],
  [Expire Date (participant view)],
  [Earliest Expire Cancel Date],
  [Latest Expire Cancel Date],
  [No. of Shares Granted],
  [Exercise Price per Share],
  [Vesting Schedule],
  [Early Exercise Allowed],
  [No. of Shares Vested],
  [No. of Shares Unvested],
  [Shares Exercised / Released],
  [Shares Subject To Repurchase],
  [Shares Cancelled/Expired],
  [Shares Outstanding],
  [Outstanding Unvested],
  [Outstanding Vested/Exercisable]
from {shareworks_grants}
